lots.guide_summary: Auction guide A$105 to A$230 hammer from 4 close SOLD Gowans console-plus-games lots (all opened, last 12 months); 7 further SOLD lots are category guides only (A$55 to A$160). No UNSOLD found. ASKING/aggregate PriceCharting figures (not sales) put a break-up retail value of the 10 games at about A$325 CIB and the console about A$333 loose (USD at assumed 1.52), which is far above what Tasmanian rooms pay for a mixed lot. No Armitage past results found (WebSearch cap reached this turn, could not re-search).
lots.working: Keep: lowest close same-type SOLD = Gowans 373709 $105 hammer. 105 / 1.22 = 86.07, round down to $85. This is conservative: that lot had a smaller original 3DS and 4 lesser games; ours has an XL and Phoenix Wright vs Layton. Flip: likely resale at a Tasmanian auction about $160 hammer (middle of the close SOLD range 105/140/180/230). Less 15% vendor commission (assumed) and $0 postage (sold locally) = $136. 136 / 2.44 = 55.7, round down to $55. Breaking up online (games individually) could return more, but that rests on aggregate data, not SOLD evidence, so it does not set the bid.
lots.confidence_reason: Every game label read in the photos and the console identified, 4 close SOLD Gowans comparables opened, but none is the exact same bundle (XL plus this Layton set), and console condition (screens look worn and dirty) and whether all carts are in their cases is unconfirmed.
lots.condition: Console powers on to the home menu; both screens look dirty/scuffed, lower screen notably hazy; folio case worn. Game cases look clean with covers present; contents not shown.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 2 shows the system menu running (date 11/01 Tue), so it boots. Grey Nintendo AC adapter (WAP-002 style) included. All 10 cases are PAL PG/G rated AU releases with spines read. Professor Layton vs Phoenix Wright and Last Specter are the most sought titles. No stylus visible.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are all 10 game cards inside their cases (and manuals present)? Is there a stylus? Are the screens scratched or just dirty, and do both hinges and buttons work? Has the console been reset (no Nintendo account linked)?
